shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum plunged on Nov 8 to August lows, driven by over $1 billion in liquidations.
Democratic Congress win raises concerns over stricter US crypto regulations.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw significant net outflows, pushing 2026 balance negative.
Strong US jobs report increases odds of Dec Fed rate hike, weighing on crypto.
